# Tax Calculator Australia 2026-27
## Frequently asked questions
### What are the Australian tax brackets for 2026-27?
For the 2026-27 financial year, Australian tax residents pay: nil on income up to $18,200; 15% from $18,201 to $45,000 (down from 16% on 1 July 2026); 30% from $45,001 to $135,000; 37% from $135,001 to $190,000; and 45% on income above $190,000.
